basic_info.description: This 5-unit+ building is a fantastic investment opportunity in the heart of Noe Valley! Each unit is currently tenant-occupied providing stable cash flow. The building is in average condition, making it perfect for investors looking to either maintain as-is or renovate to maximize rent potential. All units have basic finishes with functional kitchens and bathrooms. There is a large backyard, 1 car garage, and separate utility meters. The property is well-maintained with no known structural issues but could benefit from cosmetic upgrades. The City is also requiring a soft story retrofit and pre-work has been completed. Great potential for a value-add investor looking to modernize units.    Situated on a quiet, tree-lined street in Noe Valley, this property is near 24th Street's vibrant restaurants, cafes, and boutiques. Close to public transportation, parks, and tech shuttle stops, offering easy access to the rest of San Francisco and the Peninsula.    Noe Valley continues to be one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, offering a high quality of life and strong appreciation potential. This building offers a fantastic opportunity for both first-time and seasoned investors.    Schedule a viewing today and explore the possibilities this gem offer!
